body:
Describe the bug
When attempting to pull a Docker image from nvcr.io, the operation fails with an "Access Denied" error.

To Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:

    Open a terminal.
    Run the command docker login nvcr.io and authenticate successfully.
    Execute the command docker pull nvcr.io/nvidian/alpamayo/nre:25.7.9-dc9a8043.
    See error: "Error response from daemon: Head 'https://nvcr.io/v2/nvidian/alpamayo/nre/manifests/25.7.9-dc9a8043': denied: {"errors": [{"code": "DENIED", "message": "Access Denied"}]}"

Expected behavior
The Docker image should be pulled successfully without any access denied errors.

OS:                             Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS 
CUDA Version:           13.1 
Nvidia driver version: 590.48.01 
GPU:                           NVIDIA Grace Blackwell.

comments.body:
That's an internal-only image. I'm guessing you got it fromhttps://github.com/NVlabs/alpasim/blob/d1755893d1f2c7ceef642cd0a977b470eaa6c549/src/wizard/configs/deploy/local_oss_arm.yaml#L24

Sorry about the confusion, here. We'll remove this yaml file from the public repo and add a pointer to a public nurec image if it becomes available

title: Docker Image nvcr.io/nvidian/alpamayo/nre:25.7.9-dc9a8043 Access Denied.
